mapper.content:
Hi Shayna,

A Homecare application has come in, but the system couldn't automatically
match it to an existing volunteer folder. This usually means a name was
entered slightly differently between the two forms (nickname, spelling,
married name, etc).

Applicant details from this submission:

Name: {{1.firstname}} {{1.surname}}Email: {{1.email}}Phone: {{1.phone}}

What to do:
1. Check the Volunteers tab for a close match on name/email.
2. If you find them, you can proceed with their Homecare applicationmanually (or let me know and I'll adjust the record).
3. If you can't find a match, they may not have completed a Volunteer Application yet - a quick email to check makes sense (draft below).

Thanks!

here is the suggested email
To: {{1.email}}
Subject: Quick check before we can process your Homecare application

Hi {{1.firstname}},

Thanks so much for submitting a Homecare application with CAPS!

Before I can process it, I just need to double check something - I
couldn't find your Volunteer Application on file under the name/email
you used for this form. Have you completed a Volunteer Application with us before?

If yes: no problem, could you let me know what name/email you used so I can find it?

If no: you'll need to complete that first before I can approve
Homecare - here's the link: https://forms.gle/Fzw7uyZrNYgfHecu9

Thanks for your patience, and looking forward to getting you sorted!

Shayna

Welcome to CAPS!

Dear {{16.`2`}},

We are delighted to welcome you to the Cape Animal Protection Shelter Inc. (CAPS) volunteer team!

Your application has been reviewed and approved. You are now a registered CAPS volunteer.

We will be in touch shortly with more information about the next steps on how you can get started with your volunteer activities.

If you have any questions in the meantime, please don't hesitate to contact us at info@capeanimalprotectionshelter.org.au

Thank you for giving your time to help the animals in our care.

Warm regards,

Cape Animal Protection Shelter Inc.
Weipa, Queensland
